name: Coastline College Dual and Concurrent Enrollment
city: Fountain Valley, Garden Grove, Newport Beach and Westminster, CA
what_you_do: Take college classes while you are in high school. Classes can be online, hybrid or in person. Some are just for high school students and meet at your school.
who_can_apply: High school students who finished 8th grade. You must meet each class rule. Classes just for high school students are for Garden Grove, Huntington Beach Union, Lake Elsinore and Newport-Mesa districts.
pay_detail: California residents do not pay the $46 per unit fee. You pay a $14 total charge plus books or lab fees. Partner district classes just for high school students are free.
duration: By term. Up to 11 units in fall or spring, 10 in summer, 6 in winter.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page. Term dates are on the college calendar.
how_to_apply: Apply at OpenCCCApply. A parent fills out the Parent Form once. Then send the High School Release Form each term, or the CCAP form for partner classes. Add classes in MyCoast. Questions: dualenrollment@coastline.edu.
notes: Students on some visas pay other tuition, so check with Admissions. Your high school decides if a class counts for graduation. Take classes for a letter grade if you want them to count for UC or CSU A-G. Staying past the 20% mark puts the class on your record.
